summary: The withheld ep 9 is recoverable and AFL's day/month were right: 2015-05-30 is a year corruption of 2013-05-30. Season 1 ran weekly Thursdays 2013-04-04 to 2013-06-27 with no skips, and both ja-WP's 各話リスト (初放送日) and en-WP's season-1 table give 第9話 勇者、修羅場を経験する = 2013-05-30. No day shift for this series (stored ep 8 = 2013-05-23 = published).

repairs.why: Ep 9 'The Hero Experiences a Fray' (勇者、修羅場を経験する) aired 2013-05-30. ja-WP はたらく魔王さま! (アニメ) 各話リスト 第9話 Aux5 = 5月30日 (year header 2013年); en-WP 'The Devil Is a Part-Timer! season 1' ep 9 = May 30, 2013. AFL's withheld 2015-05-30 is the same 05-30 with a corrupted year, which is why G55/G54 held it back. Eps 8 (05-23) and 10 (06-06) bracket it exactly one week either side.

structure.notes: 13 rows = season 1 only (2013-04-04..06-27, Thu, Tokyo MX). Season 2 (2022/2023) is not in this series' rows.
